title: 资深空气动力学工程师/Principle Aerodynamics Engineer
body: - 负责整车空气动力学性能的开发工作，从气动性能角度为整车外形提供设计指导及优化方案； - 负责与汽车设计团队及工程团队的协调沟通来推动气动优化工作； - 负责统筹安排整车空气动力学性能开发过程中仿真与试验验证的工作； - 负责整车CFD仿真优化及算法开发验证，包含数据准备、仿真计算、结果分析及提出优化方案等工作； - 负责整车空气动力学风洞试验，包含油泥模型制作、试验样件制作、试验样车跟踪确认、试验方案准备、试验开展及试验结果分析等工作. Responsibilities: - Responsible for the development of the vehicle's aerodynamic performance, and provide design guidance and optimization from the perspective of aerodynamic performance; - Responsible for coordinating with the design team and engineering team to implement aerodynamic optimization; - Responsible for coordinating and arranging the CFD simulation and wind tunnel test during the development of the vehicle's aerodynamic performance; - Responsible for vehicle CFD simulation and methodology development, including data preparation, simulation calculation, result analysis and proposed optimization plan; - Responsible for vehicle aerodynamic wind tunnel test, including clay model preparation, RP model preparation, test vehicle preparation, test plan preparation, test running and test result analysis. - 研究生及以上学历，流体力学、空气动力学、航空航天等相关专业； - 掌握设计相关的汽车工程理论知识； - 具备扎实空气动力学理论基础及优秀的CFD计算流体力学仿真能力； - 熟练运用STARCCM、CATIA、ANSA等软件进行数据处理和结果分析； - 熟练的英语沟通写作能力，优秀的团队内外部协调沟通能力. Job Requirements: - Graduate degree or above, major in fluid mechanics, aerodynamics, aerospace and other related fields; - Master the theoretical knowledge of automotive engineering related to design; - Possess a solid theoretical foundation of aerodynamics and excellent computational fluid dynamics simulation capabilities; - Proficiency in using STARCCM, CATIA, ANSA and other software for data processing and result analysis; - Proficient English communication and writing skills, excellent team coordination and communication skills.
